input.prompt: Explore the repository to identify its framework, current game implementation, and instructions for running/testing. Report key files and best place to implement the requested playable 3D street racing game. Do not edit files.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e38248ac3ffexQXzlHbtk37Lhq" state="completed">
## Findings

- **No game or application implementation exists yet.** The repository has no `index.html`, `package.json`, source directory, or project tests. The only tracked file is the OpenCode workflow; the remaining root files are local instructions and launcher scripts.
- **Framework:** None is configured in the project. The external OMGithub runtime supports either a plain static site rooted at `index.html` or a **Vite** project. For a modular Three.js racing game, Vite is a supported option; a plain `index.html` is the simplest option.
- **Best place to implement:** Start in the repository root, which is currently empty of application code. Either add a root `index.html`, or scaffold a Vite app there and put the game in its source entry point (for example, `src/main.js`). There is no existing game to extend.

## Key files

- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh) — invokes the external runtime’s default start script.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh) — invokes the runtime’s browser-capture script.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/Agents.md) — repository guidance, including mobile-game and browser-verification notes.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md) — OMGithub project links; no app-specific setup instructions.
- [`/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`](/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs) — runtime behavior: accepts root `index.html` or a Vite project, builds Vite to `dist`, and serves the result.
- [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/SKILL.md`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.agents/skills/load-sketchfab-threejs/SKILL.md) — optional guidance for Three.js/GLB assets; it is a bundled skill, not evidence that the project already uses Three.js.

## Running and testing

`start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR` and calls the runtime launcher. The runtime defaults to port **3000** unless `PORT` is set. For browser verification, `Agents.md` instead mentions opening **`http://localhost:3002`** for a “Pascal development server”; that instruction does not match the current launcher, which supports static HTML/Vite and defaults to port 3000. Confirm the actual port provided by the environment before testing.

`capture.sh` requires `CAPTURE_URL` and `CAPTURE_DIR`; the runtime capture script takes desktop and mobile screenshots. The project currently has no app or test suite to run, so browser verification becomes relevant after implementation.
</subagent>
